title: Unveiling the role of ABI3 and hub senescence-related genes in macrophage senescence for atherosclerotic plaque progression.
authors: Fu, Yajuan; Zhang, Juan; Liu, Qiujun; Yang, Lan; Wu, Qianqian; Yang, Xiaomin; Wang, Lexin; Ding, Ning; Xiong, Jiantuan; Gao, Yujing; Ma, Shengchao; Jiang, Yideng
journal: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦动脉粥样硬化中巨噬细胞衰老相关基因ABI3的功能与机制，属于纯疾病生物学与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atherosclerosis, characterized by abnormal arterial lipid deposition, is an age-dependent inflammatory disease and contributes to elevated morbidity and mortality. Senescent foamy macrophages are considered to be deleterious at all stages of atherosclerosis, while the underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. In this study, we aimed to explore the senescence-related genes in macrophages diagnosis for atherosclerotic plaque progression. METHODS: The atherosclerosis-related datasets were retrieved from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database, and cellular senescence-associated genes were acquired from the CellAge database. R package Limma was used to screen out the differentially expressed senescence-related genes (DE-SRGs), and then three machine learning algorithms were applied to determine the hub DE-SRGs. Next, we established a nomogram model to further confirm the clinical significance of hub DE-SRGs. Finally, we validated the expression of hub SRG ABI3 by Sc-RNA seq analysis and explored the underlying mechanism of ABI3 in THP-1-derived macrophages and mouse atherosclerotic lesions. RESULTS: A total of 15 DE-SRGs were identified in macrophage-rich plaques, with five hub DE-SRGs (ABI3, CAV1, NINJ1, Nox4 and YAP1) were further screened using three machine learning algorithms. Subsequently, a nomogram predictive model confirmed the high validity of the five hub DE-SRGs for evaluating atherosclerotic plaque progression. Further, the ABI3 expression was upregulated in macrophages of advanced plaques and senescent THP-1-derived macrophages, which was consistent with the bioinformatics analysis. ABI3 knockdown abolished macrophage senescence, and the NF-kappaB signaling pathway contributed to ABI3-mediated macrophage senescence. CONCLUSION: We identified five cellular senescence-associated genes for atherogenesis progression and unveiled that ABI3 might promote macrophage senescence via activation of the NF-kappaB pathway in atherogenesis progression, which proposes new preventive and therapeutic strategies of senolytic agents for atherosclerosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：动脉粥样硬化（atherosclerosis）以动脉脂质异常沉积为特征，是一种年龄依赖性炎症性疾病，导致发病率和死亡率升高。衰老的泡沫巨噬细胞被认为在动脉粥样硬化的所有阶段均具有有害作用，但其潜在机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。本研究旨在探索巨噬细胞中与衰老相关的基因，用于诊断动脉粥样硬化斑块进展。方法：从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据库获取动脉粥样硬化相关数据集，并从CellAge数据库获取细胞衰老相关基因。使用R包Limma筛选差异表达的衰老相关基因（DE-SRGs），随后应用三种机器学习算法确定核心DE-SRGs。接下来，我们建立了一个列线图模型以进一步确认核心DE-SRGs的临床意义。最后，我们通过单细胞RNA测序（Sc-RNA seq）分析验证了核心SRG ABI3的表达，并探讨了ABI3在THP-1来源巨噬细胞和小鼠动脉粥样硬化病变中的潜在机制。结果：在富含巨噬细胞的斑块中共鉴定出15个DE-SRGs，其中五个核心DE-SRGs（ABI3、CAV1、NINJ1、Nox4和YAP1）通过三种机器学习算法进一步筛选。随后，列线图预测模型确认了这五个核心DE-SRGs在评估动脉粥样硬化斑块进展方面具有高度有效性。此外，ABI3在晚期斑块巨噬细胞和衰老的THP-1来源巨噬细胞中表达上调，这与生物信息学分析一致。ABI3敲低消除了巨噬细胞衰老，且NF-kappaB信号通路参与了ABI3介导的巨噬细胞衰老。结论：我们鉴定了五个与细胞衰老相关的基因参与动脉粥样硬化进展，并揭示ABI3可能通过激活NF-kappaB通路促进动脉粥样硬化进展中的巨噬细胞衰老，这为动脉粥样硬化的衰老溶解剂预防和治疗策略提出了新方向。
